# `assistant` operations

The exact fields each `assistant.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `assistant.ask`

Ask the Loom assistant one question about this namespace and get one cited answer: what it holds, how it is used, counts over its rows, and how to write it better.

`POST /v1/assistant.ask` · MCP `loom_assistant_ask` · role `viewer` · write · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `question` | `str` | required | The question about this namespace, answered as the caller, at most 20,000 characters. |
| `history` | `list[AssistantMessage]` | *(computed)* | Earlier turns of the conversation, oldest first, at most 50; empty by default. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `answer` | `str` | The assistant's answer, with its citations as the agent wrote them. |
| `run_id` | `str` | The answer's id: the run its tool calls are ledgered under (agent_events.run_id). |
| `model` | `str` | The model that answered. |
| `citations` | `list[AssistantCitation]` | Each citation in `answer`, checked when the answer ended. |
| `support` | `str` | How far the answer rests on what Loom holds: "supported" (a citation verified), "unsupported" (a citation failed, or it cites nothing although its calls found citable rows), "unchecked" (its checks could not say) or "none" (it makes no… |
